commands.name: /finish
commands.short_description: Log a VN as finished. Pool VNs earn more points.
commands.description: Log a VN you finished. It earns more points while it is one of this server's monthly, seasonal or special picks. You can log the same VN again in a later month for a re-read; the same VN twice in one month is refused.
commands.parameters:
• `title`: Search for a VN by title (type at least 2 characters to search VNDB)
• `comment`: Your review/thoughts (max 2000 characters)
• `rating`: Your rating on your own scale (1-10 by default; /settings switches between 5, 10 and 100)

commands.name: /logs
commands.short_description: Your reading record: what you logged, when, and the points it earned.
commands.description: The chronological record of a member's reading logs, newest first: log number (used by /log_edit and /log_undo), month, VN, points, rating and a one-line comment preview. For scores sorted best first and full comments, use /ratings user:.
commands.parameters: • `user`: Optional - The user whose logs you want to view (defaults to yourself)

commands.name: /ratings
commands.short_description: Members' scores for a VN, highest first, with their comments and VNDB notes.
commands.description: With `title:`, one line per member of this server who rated or reviewed the VN: their VNDB vote, their VN Club rating on their own scale, and a preview of their comment or VNDB note. Sorted by VNDB vote where a member has one, otherwise by VN Club rating. With `user:`, the same list for one member's VNs. The 📖 Full reviews button opens every written comment and note, visible only to you.
commands.parameters:
• `title`: The VN (autocomplete)
• `user`: Show this member's ratings instead
• `source`: Optional - Both (default), VN Club logs only, or VNDB lists only

commands.name: /log_edit
commands.short_description: Edit the comment or rating on a reading log.
commands.description: Edit the comment or rating on a reading log. You can edit your own logs; managers can edit any user's log in their server. A comment-only edit keeps the rating on the scale it was written on; a new rating is read on the log owner's current scale.
commands.parameters:
• `log_id`: The ID of the log to edit (autocomplete shows your logs)
• `comment`: Optional - New comment (max 2000 characters)
• `rating`: Optional - New rating on the log owner's current scale

commands.name: /log_undo
commands.short_description: Delete one of your reading logs.
commands.description: Delete one of your reading logs. You can only delete your own logs unless you have admin permissions.
commands.parameters: • `log_id`: The ID of the log to delete (autocomplete shows your logs)

commands.name: /settings
commands.short_description: Your personal settings, such as the scale you rate on.
commands.description: Opens your settings privately, with a menu to change each one. Currently: the rating scale your ratings are typed on (1-10 by default). Ratings you already logged keep the scale they were written on and are shown that way to everyone; averages combine all scales and show out of 10. Pass `rating_scale:` to change it directly.
commands.parameters: • `rating_scale`: Optional - Set your rating scale without opening the menu

commands.name: /profile
commands.short_description: User stats card image (points, completions, avg rating, badges, activity).
commands.description: A member's stats card: avatar, total points, VNs and monthly picks finished, average rating out of 10, most active server, linked VNDB account, badges, and a six-month activity chart. Pass `embed:true` to also get a text version.
commands.parameters:
• `user`: Optional - The user whose profile you want to view (defaults to yourself)
• `embed`: Optional - Also send a text version of the card (default: false)

commands.name: /badges
commands.short_description: Achievements grid image: every badge, earned and locked.
commands.description: Show a member's achievements grid, grouped into volume (VNs finished), pool picks (monthly and seasonal picks read in their window), engagement (special picks, voting, nominating), season leaderboard placings, and consistency (months logged). Badges are worked out from existing logs and votes, so past reading counts. Earned badges are in colour, locked ones dimmed. /finish also announces new badges.
commands.parameters: • `user`: Optional - whose badges to show (defaults to yourself)

commands.name: /club_stats
commands.short_description: Server-wide stats dashboard image (or global across all servers).
commands.description: A stats dashboard image for this server: total points, completions, unique VNs, active members, rating distribution, top 5 contributors and a 12-month completion chart. Pass `scope:global` to combine every server the bot is in.
commands.parameters: • `scope`: Optional - `server` (default) for this server only, or `global` for every server combined.

commands.name: /leaderboard
commands.short_description: Top users by total points. Filter by month, season, or server.
commands.description: Members ranked by total points. Filter by month, season (Winter/Spring/Summer/Fall) and/or server. Seasons: Winter Jan to Mar, Spring Apr to Jun, Summer Jul to Sep, Fall Oct to Dec.
commands.parameters:
• `month`: Optional - Filter by specific month (e.g., '2025-09'). Cannot be combined with `season`.
• `season`: Optional - Filter by season (3-month range). Cannot be combined with `month`.
• `year`: Optional - Year for the season filter. Defaults to the current calendar year. Requires `season` to be set.
• `server`: Optional - Filter by specific server (autocomplete available)

commands.name: /server_leaderboard
commands.short_description: Servers ranked by total points, with the top 5 contributors per server.
commands.description: Show server-specific leaderboards ranking the top servers by total points, with the top 5 contributors from each. Filter by month or by season (3-month range).
commands.parameters:
• `month`: Optional - Filter by specific month (e.g., '2025-09'). Cannot be combined with `season`.
• `season`: Optional - Filter by season. Cannot be combined with `month`.
• `year`: Optional - Year for the season filter. Defaults to the current calendar year. Requires `season` to be set.

commands.name: /vndb
commands.short_description: A VN's page: details, VNDB score, and who read it in this server.
commands.description: A short card for a VN: title, developer, release year, length, a short description, the VNDB score, VN Club readers and average across all servers, and this server's readers, average and most recent reader. Buttons open VNDB, jiten.moe, the ⭐ Ratings list and ℹ️ Full info (the full description, release date, length, tags, platforms, related VNs, links and jiten.moe stats). Ratings and Full info open privately for whoever presses them.
commands.parameters: • `title`: The VN (autocomplete)

commands.name: /vndb_link
commands.short_description: Link or unlink your VNDB account.
commands.usage: /vndb_link account:<username, user id or profile URL> | action:Unlink
commands.description: Links your VNDB account so your public list feeds /ratings, the VNDB leaderboards and your profile. The bot keeps a copy of entries under public labels only and refreshes it daily. Each VNDB account can be linked by one member. Run it again to refresh your list. Pick `action: Unlink` to remove your link and delete the bot's copy of your list.
commands.parameters:
• `account`: Your VNDB username, user id, or profile URL (needed to link)
• `action`: Optional - Link (default) or Unlink

commands.name: /vndb_profile
commands.short_description: Quick link to a member's VNDB profile.
commands.description: Replies with a link to the member's VNDB profile. For their scores use /ratings user:, for their VN Club stats /profile.
commands.parameters: • `user`: Optional - whose profile to link (defaults to you)

commands.name: /vndb_user_leaderboard
commands.short_description: Member rankings from linked VNDB lists, with each member's VNDB profile.
commands.description: Ranks members with a linked VNDB account by Most finished (default) or Most votes cast, showing each member's Discord name and linked VNDB account. The all-time list includes every linked member, so it also shows who has linked an account.
commands.parameters:
• `category`: Optional - Most finished (default) or Most votes cast
• `timeframe`: Optional - All-time (default) or this year
• `server`: Optional - Only members who linked or logged reads in that server

commands.name: /vndb_leaderboard
commands.short_description: VN rankings from linked VNDB lists: most-read, highest and lowest rated.
commands.description: Ranks VNs using linked members' public VNDB lists: Most-read VNs, Highest-rated VNs and Lowest-rated VNs. The rated lists need at least 3 votes from linked members per VN. For rankings of members, use /vndb_user_leaderboard.
commands.parameters:
• `category`: What to rank
• `timeframe`: Optional - All-time (default) or this year, by finish or vote date
• `server`: Optional - Only members who linked or logged reads in that server

commands.name: /pool
commands.short_description: Browse picks + nominations for a given month with prev/next navigation.
commands.description: Browse this server's pool for a month, the current one by default. The pool holds manager picks (monthly, seasonal, special) and members' nominations with their vote result. Every entry has a number; `/pool_entry id:N` shows its detail. Use the buttons under the list to move between months; the filter and scope stay. Seasonal picks span a whole season, so they have their own view: press 🌸 Seasonal view. `all_servers:true` lists every server's entries, each marked with its server.
commands.parameters:
• `month`: Optional - Target month 1-12. Defaults to the current month.
• `year`: Optional - Target year. Defaults to the current year.
• `filter`: Optional - `all` (default), `monthly`, `special`, or `nominations`. Seasonal picks are in the 🌸 Seasonal view instead.
• `all_servers`: Optional - Include entries from every server (default: this server only).

commands.name: /pool_entry
commands.short_description: Show full detail for a pool entry by ID.
commands.description: Full detail for one pool entry: cover, description, status, period, points, the vote it came from, who nominated it, and recent completions in this server. Works for picks, open nominations, and vote winners and losers alike. The `id` autocomplete lists this server's entries.
commands.parameters: • `id`: The pool entry ID (autocomplete suggests entries from this server).

commands.name: /monthly
commands.short_description: Banner card for this server's current monthly VNs.
commands.description: Post a banner for this server's current monthly VNs. Seasonal picks have their own banner, see `/seasonal`. The banner shows the cover, title, length, character count, difficulty, VNDB score, unique kanji, dialogue share and characters per day over the month, with VNDB and jiten.moe buttons. Pass `embed:true` for a text version instead.
commands.parameters: • `embed`: Optional - Send a text version instead of the banner image (default: false)

commands.name: /seasonal
commands.short_description: Banner card for this server's current seasonal VNs.
commands.description: Post a banner for this server's current seasonal VNs. Same layout as /monthly, labelled with the season, and characters per day spread over the three months. VNDB and jiten.moe buttons included. Pass `embed:true` for a text version instead.
commands.parameters: • `embed`: Optional - Send a text version instead of the banner image (default: false)

commands.name: /season_overview
commands.short_description: Composite image: seasonal banner on top + each month's monthly picks.
commands.description: One image for a whole season: the seasonal VN banner on top, and below it each month's monthly VNs. Defaults to the current season; pass `season` (and `year`) for another. Without a seasonal pick for the period, the reply is text. VNDB and jiten.moe buttons are included for the seasonal pick.
commands.parameters:
• `season`: Optional - Winter / Spring / Summer / Fall. Defaults to the current season.
• `year`: Optional - Year for the season. Defaults to the current calendar year. Requires `season` to be set.

commands.name: /theme
commands.short_description: Show the nomination theme for an upcoming month or season.
commands.description: Show the nomination theme in force for a period, as a card listing every rule it applies plus real VNDB titles that satisfy it. Defaults to the period /nominate targets (next month), so running it bare tells you what to nominate for next. Use `status:seasonal` for the seasonal lane and `target_month` to look further ahead. Says so plainly when a period has no theme. The example titles come from a live VNDB search built from the same rules the gate enforces, so anything shown would be accepted; rules VNDB can't search on (character count) are called out on the card.
commands.parameters:
• `status`: Optional - Which nomination lane, `monthly` (default) or `seasonal`.
• `target_month`: Optional - YYYY-MM period. Defaults to the period /nominate targets.

commands.name: /nominate
commands.short_description: Nominate a VN for an upcoming monthly or seasonal voting.
commands.description: Nominate a VN for an upcoming vote in this server. Nominations stay until voting opens, so no vote needs to be running. One nomination per member per period. Monthly and seasonal votes are separate: pick one with `status` (monthly by default). When a manager opens voting, every nomination for that period goes on the ballot. Your nomination gets a pool entry number shown in /pool; /pool_entry id:N shows it.
commands.parameters:
• `title`: Search for a VN by title (type at least 2 characters to search VNDB)
• `status`: Optional - `monthly` (default) or `seasonal`
• `target_month`: Optional - YYYY-MM (default: next month, or next season for seasonal)

commands.name: /vote
commands.short_description: Open a personal voting menu for the open votes in this server.
commands.description: Opens a private copy of this server's open vote: same nominees, same controls, same role requirements. Handy when the vote message has scrolled away. Shows both the monthly and the seasonal vote when both are open. You can also vote with the buttons on the vote message itself.
commands.parameters: _(none: the menu shows whichever votes are open in this server.)_

commands.name: /manage_pool
commands.short_description: Manager: add, edit, or remove pool entries.
commands.description: Manager-only. Add, edit or remove entries in this server's pool. The `title` autocomplete follows the action: it searches VNDB on add and lists pool entries with their numbers on edit and remove. On edit, anything left out stays as it is. One entry at a time.
commands.parameters:
• `action`: `add`, `edit`, or `remove`
• `title`: A VN to add, or the pool entry to edit or remove (autocomplete)
• `start_month`: (add/edit) First month the entry is active. YYYY-MM.
• `end_month`: (add/edit) Last month the entry is active. YYYY-MM.
• `points`: (add/edit) Points for finishing it while active. Default 10 on add.
• `status`: (add/edit) `monthly` (default), `seasonal`, `special`, or `nominated` to turn a pick back into a nomination.
• `guild_id`: (add/edit) Bot operators only. A server ID, or `NULL` to share the entry with every server.

commands.name: /manage_voting
commands.short_description: Manager: open the voting dashboard (votes and settings).
commands.description: Manager-only. Opens a private dashboard showing the monthly and the seasonal vote, with buttons for what can be done next: open voting (target month, choice mode, number of winners, duration), post the vote message in this channel, close or cancel voting, and set server defaults (voting role, vote layout). Monthly and seasonal votes run independently. Closing adds the winners to the pool and updates the vote message with the final standings; announce the winner with /monthly or /seasonal.
commands.parameters: _(none: the dashboard collects everything through its buttons and forms.)_

commands.name: /manage_theme
commands.short_description: Manager: set nomination themes for a month or season.
commands.description: Manager-only. Opens a private dashboard for nomination themes. Build reusable themes (developers, required or excluded tags, length, character count, release window, NSFW cover policy), with search-then-pick for tags and developers, then apply one to an upcoming month or season. While a theme is set, /nominate only accepts VNs that fit and tells the member which rule failed; managers get a warning instead of a refusal. Members can check the theme with /theme. Applying copies the theme's rules onto the period, so later edits to the theme leave it unchanged. Clearing a period lifts the restriction.
commands.parameters: _(none: the dashboard collects everything through its buttons and forms.)_

commands.name: /manage_reward_points
commands.short_description: Manager: manually award (or deduct) points to a user.
commands.description: Manager-only. Award points to a member by hand, for events, read-alongs or a missed completion. The award shows in their logs with the reason given.
commands.parameters:
• `member`: The user to reward.
• `points`: How many points to grant (integer; can be negative to deduct).
• `reason`: Free-text reason recorded on the log entry.

commands.name: /manage_log
commands.short_description: Manager: record a VN completion on behalf of another user.
commands.description: Manager-only. Log a finished VN for a member who didn't run /finish. The month defaults to the current one and points are worked out as /finish does; pass `points` to override. The same VN can be logged again in a different month for a re-read; to change an existing log, use /log_edit.
commands.parameters:
• `member`: The user to log a completion for.
• `title`: Search for a VN by title (autocomplete).
• `rating`: On the member's own rating scale (1-10 unless they changed it).
• `comment`: The comment/review text (max 2000 chars).
• `reward_month`: Optional override (YYYY-MM). Defaults to current month.
• `points`: Optional override. Defaults to the same calculation /finish uses.
commands.example: /manage_log member:@JohnDoe title:Muramasa rating:9 comment:Backfilled their completion from last week

commands.name: /manage_vndb_link
commands.short_description: Manager: remove a member's VNDB link.
commands.description: Manager-only. Removes a member's VNDB link and cached list, for example when an account was linked by someone who doesn't own it.
commands.parameters: • `user`: The member whose link to remove

commands.name: /manage_visibility
commands.short_description: Manager: choose where command replies are posted publicly.
commands.description: Opens a private panel. Replies are shown only to the person who ran the command, except in the channels picked here (up to 25), or everywhere when the mode is Public everywhere. Threads and forum posts follow their parent channel. Separately, a manager can post any single reply in the channel by passing `public: True` to the command, and anyone can pass `public: False` to keep a reply private in an open channel.
commands.parameters: _(none: the panel has a mode menu and a channel picker.)_

commands.name: /help
commands.short_description: Browse the commands by category. Only you see the reply.
commands.description: Opens a short menu of command categories; pick one to see its commands, then pick a command for full detail. Everything is shown only to you and stays in one message, so nothing is posted to the channel. Pass `command:` to jump straight to one command.
commands.parameters: • `command`: Optional - Jump straight to one command's full detail
